title: Arrival of Amels 60 at Vlissingen for Outfitting
description: The Amels 60 superyacht, latest in the series, arrives at Vlissingen for outfitting, promising innovation and elegance in yacht design.
html:
The newest 60-meter superyacht from the Amels Limited Editions line has reached Damen Yachting’s Vlissingen facility, where it will undergo outfitting. This follows the completion of its hull construction at Damen’s Gydnia shipyard in Poland. The yacht, which is the eighth hull in the Amels 60 series, is slated for delivery in 2027. This marks a significant milestone in the series, which has seen considerable success in the global market.

The Vlissingen facility is well-equipped to handle the outfitting process, ensuring that each yacht meets the highest standards of quality and performance. Project Manager Joppe Osté expressed confidence in the upcoming phase, highlighting the expertise of the team involved. The facility’s capabilities will be leveraged to integrate the advanced systems and bespoke features that define the Amels 60 series.

Espen Øino and Laura Sessa Lead Design Team

The design of the Amels 60 series is spearheaded by renowned designer Espen Øino, whose expertise in yacht design is well-regarded in the industry. His vision for this series combines sleek aesthetics with functional design elements, ensuring that each vessel not only looks impressive but also performs efficiently. The collaboration with Laura Sessa for the yacht’s interiors adds a layer of sophistication, as her custom designs are tailored to meet the specific preferences of discerning clients.

Laura Sessa’s team brings a wealth of experience, particularly in working with the Amels Limited Editions line. Their approach to interior design emphasizes both comfort and elegance, creating spaces that are both inviting and practical. This partnership aims to deliver a yacht that reflects the highest standards of craftsmanship and design innovation.

Amels 60 Series: Hybrid Propulsion and Global Reach

The Amels 60 series is notable for its incorporation of hybrid propulsion technology, aligning with modern environmental standards. These yachts are designed to meet IMO Tier III emissions requirements, showcasing Damen Yachting’s commitment to sustainability. The hybrid systems not only reduce emissions but also enhance fuel efficiency, making these vessels a forward-thinking choice for owners.

Currently, seven units from the Amels 60 series are operational worldwide, predominantly serving charter markets in the Mediterranean and Caribbean. This global presence underscores the series’ appeal and versatility, catering to a diverse range of clients. Damen Yachting, as part of the Damen Shipyards Group, continues to expand its influence in the yacht-building sector, supported by a skilled workforce of approximately 500 professionals.

The arrival of the latest Amels 60 at Vlissingen marks another step forward for Damen Yachting’s innovative series. With a strong design team and advanced technology, the yacht is poised to meet the demands of a discerning global clientele. As the outfitting process begins, the focus remains on delivering a vessel that embodies both performance and elegance.
